overview.description: The Hotchkis & Wiley Opportunities Fund ETF (HWO) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in target outcome asset allocation. The fund is an actively managed fund that invests in undervalued securities of any size while taking advantage of special situations through bonds, preferred stock, and merger arbitrage. HWO was launched on Jul 22, 2026 and is issued by Hotchkis & Wiley.

data.text: LOS ANGELES--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Global investment manager Hotchkis & Wiley launches new ETF share classes for two existing mutual funds with HWIV and HWO.
